event_corrections.source: KO 2406.80. J spawned 2406.27 and was held at 2406.33, so O came out of hold. O locked bottom-right at ~2406.47, the bottom row flashed white at ~2406.53 and the banner went from 4 REN to 5 REN at ~2406.60, all before the KO tilt. Score 124230 -> 125318 (+1088 = single with REN bonus). The row held only player pieces, no grey. Images: fr/g1/s032a.png, fr/g1/s032b.png

The piece spawned at 3395.20 is real (nextcount shift 3395.200, T held 3395.333), but the score only rises by drop points, 10917 -> 10926 -> 10948 -> 10982 (3395.07-3395.83), with no ~5700 jump. The B2B TSD is the 3393.63 clear: score 5367 -> 10917 at 3394.47 (+5550 = TSD x1.5 + 150 REN). Every later clear in 3397-3404 matches the score exactly, so the -5565 unexplained is this phantom TSD. Score read by score.py

Frames 3479.95-3480.75 (fr/g1/s046b.png, fr/g1/s046a.png): L spawned 3480.03, locked ~3480.12 and made the PERFECT CLEAR triple (score 48734 at 3480.15). The I spawned 3480.23 and locked at once (+38 -> 48772 at 3480.25); the S spawned ~3480.35 and locked (+36 -> 48808 at 3480.50); then T was held and Z dropped (48844 at 3480.65), which is the chain's 3480.57 event. The chain had one event, the PC triple timed at the I spawn, for three locks (L, I, S). The +72 at 3480.67 is the S and Z drop points. Nothing locked after the 3481.13 O: J spawned 3481.43, was held at 3481.5 and T came out, still falling at the KO (3481.63)

KO 3702.07. O locked 3701.77 (score 39818, the chain's 3701.57 event). Z spawned 3701.87 and locked upright at the right at ~3702.03 (score 39818 -> 39850, the Z drawn solid) before the KO; no row flashed. Image: fr/g1/s050.png
